description: This header file declares functions for sending IEEE 1905.1/1a messages and related packets such as LLDP bridge discovery. It includes function prototypes for forwarding raw 1905 packets, sending raw 1905 packets, sending LLDP packets, and obtaining TLV data from interfaces. It defines external dependencies on other modules like '1905_cmdus.h', '1905_tlvs.h', and 'i1905.h'.

methods.name: forward1905RawPacket
methods.description: Sends a raw 1905 packet using the specified network interface, with options to set source MAC from stream or local MAC.

methods.name: send1905RawPacket
methods.description: Sends a raw 1905 packet on the specified interface with the given message ID, destination MAC, and packet content.

methods.name: sendLLDPBridgeDiscoveryPacket
methods.description: Sends an LLDP bridge discovery packet over the specified interface with provided source MAC and payload.

methods.name: obtainTLVFrom1905
methods.description: Retrieves specific TLV information from a network interface based on provided parameters.
